offers_products.reason: Auction marketplace; it mostly facilitates sales of others' assets. SmartEquip and Rouse data software are minor side lines.

offers_services.reason: Auction and marketplace transaction services, plus financing, inspection, refurbishing, shipping and vehicle remarketing for insurers (IAA).

sells_to_consumers.reason: Buyers are dealers, rebuilders, contractors and businesses; sellers are insurers, fleets and OEMs, though some individuals bid on vehicles.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Sellers include insurers, rental companies, OEMs, government and lenders; buyers include dealers, contractors and resellers.

recurring_revenue.reason: Revenue is commissions and fees per auction transaction; repeat consignors exist but each sale is transactional, not contracted.

cyclical_demand.reason: Heavy equipment auction volumes and prices swing with construction and the economy; vehicle volumes depend on claims.

big_ticket.reason: Buyers pay large prices for equipment, but the company earns modest commissions and fees per lot; many vehicles are low-value.

people_delivered.reason: Value comes from marketplace platform, yard network and buyer base, not mainly staff time.

large_customers.reason: Main sellers are insurers, rental companies, OEMs, government agencies and lenders, which are large enterprises.

asset_heavy.reason: Runs 60+ full-service yards and vehicle storage sites, which need heavy property investment.

notes: IAA vehicle remarketing and Ritchie Bros. equipment auctions are both large; the answers treat the company as one marketplace business.
